mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_message (id, topic, event_key, payload, status, retry_count, next_execute_time, last_error) VALUES (#{id}, #{topic}, #{eventKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), #{status}, COALESCE(#{retryCount}, 0), #{nextExecuteTime}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, event_key, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$')) AS payload, status, retry_count, next_execute_time, last_error, create_time FROM event_message WHERE status = 0 AND (next_execute_time IS NULL OR next_execute_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_execute_time ASC, create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE event_message SET status = 1, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE event_message SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_execute_time = #{nextExecuteTime}, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
